gloss: to restrain; to detain; to bind

definitions.gloss: to detain; to take into custody; to hold
definitions.explanation: To physically confine or hold someone, especially by legal or police authority. Used for arrests, detentions, and custody.

definitions.gloss: to restrain; to restrict; to bind
definitions.explanation: To limit someone's freedom of action or movement, whether physically or through rules, obligations, or agreements.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb composed of {拘|こう} (seize, detain) + {束|そく} (bind, bundle). Has both a concrete legal/physical sense (detaining a person) and an abstract sense (being bound by rules or obligations).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拘束|こうそく}する: to detain a suspect
- ⟦{身柄|みがら}→身柄：18826_migara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拘束|こうそく}する: to take someone into custody
- ⟦{拘束|こうそく}→拘束：02803_kousoku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: hours of obligation (time one is tied up)
- ⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧{拘束力|こうそくりょく}: legal binding force
- {拘束|こうそく}される: to be detained / to be bound

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to arrest — formal legal arrest, stronger than detention
- ⟦{束縛|そくばく}→束縛：15712_sokubaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to restrain, to shackle — often for personal or emotional restraint
- ⟦{制約|せいやく}→制約：11811_seiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to restrict, to constrain — for limitations on actions or choices
- ⟦{監禁|かんきん}→監禁：13647_kankin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confine, to imprison — longer-term physical confinement
